wire.t: Week 9 is one game from done: Bills at Vikings is tonight. Catfan94’s Farm Team leads Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 74.12, Kraft for Cash leads I Chase Brown Kids 115.14 to 99.86, Hold My DK leads Bourbon Lover 147.12 to 70.10, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte leads OBJAY 115.16 to 83.38.

The only matchup that can really flip tonight is LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix (Catfan94) at 133.48 against The Champ (TJohn91) at 127.74. Josh Allen is still to play for Catfan94, and The Champ has nobody left.

Dude, Your Getting a Dell (Br0phy) trails Asian Jim 71.10 to 86.00 with Carson Wentz still to play on Monday night. OBJAY has James Cook III and Dalton Kincaid left against StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte’s 31.78-point lead.
C.J. Stroud scored 50.36 on Jefferson’s Reserve’s bench on Sunday, and Jefferson’s Reserve lost by 106.18 with Justin Jefferson still to play tonight.
Shedeur Sanders scored 29.68 on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte’s bench, and Kayshon Boutte had 29.5 on The Champ’s bench. The Champ is 5.74 behind LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix.

Transactions since Friday's three-trade pile: Bourbon Lover (paknight12) dropped Kendre Miller and Raheim Sanders on Saturday, and Hold My DK (TheMoneyTeam2302) dropped Mack Hollins on Sunday. No new trades.

stories.title: One game left in Week 9, and LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix leads The Champ by 5.74
stories.dek: Josh Allen plays tonight for Catfan94, who is 7‑1 and 133.48 against TJohn91's 127.74.
body: Sunday is done and Bills at Vikings is the last game of Week 9. The only matchup it can really swing is LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix against The Champ. Catfan94 has 133.48 behind Jordan Love's 42.18, Ja'Marr Chase's 30.0 and Brock Bowers's 24.3. TJohn91 has 127.74 with Joe Burrow at 35.54 and Matthew Golden at 30.4, and nobody left to play.

Kayshon Boutte had 29.5 on The Champ's bench. Boutte's 29.5 would have flipped the 5.74-point gap, and Tee Higgins had 18.7 in the lineup. Allen still has to play tonight, so the bench may not even matter.

Catfan94's Farm Team beat Jefferson’s Reserve 180.30 to 74.12 after being 26.48 down on Thursday. Kenneth Walker III had 36.8, Brock Purdy 31.28 and Christian Watson 28.6, and jrsmith1391 gets the top score of the week for it. Justin Jefferson is still to play for jmello16, who left 50.36 from C.J. Stroud on the bench.

The close ones tonight: Asian Jim leads Dude, Your Getting a Dell 86.00 to 71.10 with Carson Wentz left for Br0phy, and OBJAY is 31.78 behind StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte with James Cook III and Dalton Kincaid still to play.

stories.title: Stroud 50.36, Sanders 29.68, Boutte 29.5: three benches that cost real points
stories.dek: Jefferson’s Reserve, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte and The Champ each left a big score on the pine.
body: C.J. Stroud had 50.36 on the bench for Jefferson’s Reserve. That's more than any starter on any team scored this week, and Kirk Cousins at 13.64 was in the lineup instead.

Shedeur Sanders had 29.68 on the bench for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte, and Bill_Buttlicker started Drake Maye at 24.76 in the superflex slot. That's a bad lineup call by the guy writing this site, and yes it's already in the hot seat section.

Kayshon Boutte (29.5) on The Champ's bench is the one that stings most because The Champ is 5.74 behind LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix. The other bench stories are Darren Waller's 25.0 for Hold My DK and Justice Hill's 18.7 for Asian Jim.

stories.title: The Champ and Bourbon Lover aren't done: Friday's three trades play out in the box scores
stories.dek: Burrow had 35.54 for The Champ, and Bourbon Lover is on the other side with 70.10 and three players left tonight.
body: Friday's nine-player deal sent Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins and Mark Andrews to The Champ, and Burrow and Higgins combined for 54.24 on Sunday. Bourbon Lover went the other way with Lamar Jackson, who is headed for injured reserve with a thumb injury, plus Sam LaPorta and Zay Flowers, and Flowers has since moved to Kraft for Cash.

Bourbon Lover sits at 70.10 against Hold My DK's 147.12, with Aaron Jones Sr., Keon Coleman and Khalil Shakir still to play tonight. paknight12 is 3‑5, and the trade capital from the Friday deals puts the team in long-term sell mode.
Hold My DK, meanwhile, still has no first-round picks in 2027, 2028 or 2029. TheMoneyTeam2302 is trading future for present and the present is 7‑1 going in.

columnists.name: Hugh G. Rection
columnists.bio: Has never once lowered his voice. Writes from a basement shrine to Boston sports in pajama pants, fueled by Dunkin'. Believes every 4-2 team is either a dynasty or a disgrace.

columnists.name: Richard "Dick" Gozinya
columnists.bio: Press-box regular with a pocket square and a former linebacker's bedside manner. Blunt, polished, and always one sentence away from calling you soft.

columnists.name: Holden McGroin
columnists.bio: Finished 14th in a 12-team league once. Nobody knows how. Files his columns from the porch of a trailer with a laptop he calls 'the press credential' and gives advice anyway.

columnists.name: Ivana Humpalot
columnists.bio: Covers the league from the sideline with a media pass and a spreadsheet for everything. None of her spreadsheets are correct, and she will defend every one of them.

columns.title: 50.36 ON THE BENCH!!
columns.dek: C.J. Stroud made more points sitting down than most teams made standing up.
body: C.J. STROUD HAD 50.36 ON THE BENCH FOR JEFFERSON’S RESERVE! THAT'S MORE THAN ANY STARTER IN THE LEAGUE THIS WEEK! JMELLO16 STARTED KIRK COUSINS AT 13.64!
JEFFERSON’S RESERVE LOST 180.30 TO 74.12! THAT'S A 106.18-POINT BEATING! AND THE FIX WAS SITTING ON HIS OWN BENCH!
AND LIGMA IS ONLY UP 5.74 ON THE CHAMP WITH JOSH ALLEN TO PLAY! DON'T TOUCH THAT REMOTE!

columns.title: Boutte is the whole story
columns.dek: 29.5 on the bench, and a 5.74-point gap.
body: Kayshon Boutte had 29.5 on The Champ's bench. The Champ trails LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix by 5.74.
TJohn91 won two titles in two years. That's a real résumé. You don't lose it by leaving 29.5 on the bench once. You lose it by doing it twice.
Allen plays tonight. If he scores, none of it matters. If he doesn't, it's Boutte.

columns.title: 3 tips on benches, from Holden McGroin, who has never once checked his bench
columns.dek: A bench is a place for players who have 0.00. Right?
body: 1. Check your bench on Saturday. C.J. Stroud had 50.36 on Jefferson’s Reserve's bench, and that's 50.36 you could have had.
2. Start the guy with the most name recognition. Shedeur Sanders had 29.68 on StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte's bench, and Drake Maye had 24.76 in the lineup. Maye is a name. Sanders is a name. Pick one.
3. Never trade a player on the day he scores. It's Friday's rule. Zay Flowers went to Bourbon Lover and then Kraft for Cash and nobody's happy.

columns.title: Jordan Love is 31.6% of a team
columns.dek: 42.18 of LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix's 133.48, and I have a chart.
body: Jordan Love scored 42.18 of LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix's 133.48. That's 31.6%. That means a third of Catfan94's team is one quarterback, and two-thirds of the team is not.
The Champ has 127.74 and Joe Burrow had 35.54 of it, or 27.8%. Burrow has the lower share, which my spreadsheet says makes him the more balanced quarterback.
The gap is 5.74. Josh Allen has to score more than 0 for the gap to grow. That's my model, and it has a 100% hit rate on Allen scoring more than 0.

exits.t: Scored 50.36 on the bench in Week 9 on a team that lost 180.30 to 74.12. Would like to be started on this team or any other team.

Scored 29.5 on the bench against a 5.74-point gap. Wants a role on a team that notices.
Scored 25.0 on the bench for a team that won 147.12 to 70.10. Hold My DK has plenty of depth, so he's one of the extras.
Scored 18.7 on the bench for the second week in a row. Wants a lineup spot on a team that's 3‑5.
Scored 18.8 on the bench in Week 9 on a team that scored 115.14. Wants a start on a team that spent a young running back to get him.
